remarks: Welcome to the beautiful Wolfpit area of Norwalk! SPACIOUS & UPDATED second FL 2 bedroom apartment on cute and quiet street. Conveniently located minutes from highways, restaurants, mall, beach and MORE. Walk to Stew Leonard's! Washer/Dryer IN UNIT bathroom! PET FRIENDLY (CASE BY CASE BASIS)! LISTING PRICE INCLUDES BASEMENT STORAGE + 2 ASSIGNED PARKING IN DRIVEWAY. NATURAL GAS heat/hot water keep the utilities LOW. Sit back and RELAX and enjoy a nice warm drink on your own private front balcony facing Roscoe. Walk into unit and flows comfortably from open living room, to full bathroom, 2 bedrooms, EIK. HARDWOOD FLOORS THROUGHOUT! Tenants may use REAR grass area to grill and treat as sitting area. PLENTY of parking on street in front of the property for guests. Ample closet/cabinet space. Tenants MUST have good credit, proof of income, and references.
